name: codex-orchestration
description: Lean seven-class orchestration with previous-task continuity.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.12.4 keeps seven outcome-based classes and fixed GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna routes while removing incident-specific prompt rules. The classifier only classifies; root derives the route. Change work launches the implementer first and the supervisor immediately next. Implementation starts while acceptance is constructed, but commit and deployment wait for acceptance. Small tweaks have no implementer checkpoint, big tweaks keep one release-candidate checkpoint, and builds retain architecture and vertical-slice checkpoints where applicable. Explicit previous-task requests still load bounded continuity. The desktop activity label remains Thinking.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
